faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment is 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II post at CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an M. Sc. in Geology/Applied Geology with 2 years of experience or an M.E./M. Tech in Water Resources/Hydrology from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the type of job offered by CSIR NEERI?
faq.answer: The job offered is contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of CSIR NEERI on or before the last date of application.
